# 0005 — Add a waiting list when a meetup is full

- Status: open
- Labels: app/backend, feature
- Found: 2026-09-16, a member asked to be notified when a full meetup frees a seat

## Problem

A meetup with `capacity` already reached refuses every further signup
with a flat 409. Members who wanted in have no way to be notified if a
spot opens up later, so they give up and go elsewhere. We want a
waiting list: once a meetup is full, further signups join a queue
instead of being rejected outright, and when a confirmed attendee
cancels, the first person on the queue takes their seat.

args.question: When a confirmed attendee cancels, is the first person on the waiting list automatically promoted to a confirmed attendee and notified, or are they notified with an invitation to claim the seat within a time window?

parts.text: I called `ask_product_owner` because the ticket does not specify whether a waitlisted member is automatically promoted and notified upon cancellation or given an invitation to claim the open seat.

criteria: Given a meetup at capacity, when a new member signs up, then they join the waiting list instead of getting a 409
Given a waiting list with at least one member, when a confirmed attendee cancels their signup, then the first member on the waiting list is promoted to attendee
Given a member already on the waiting list, when they sign up again for the same meetup, then the request is rejected as a duplicate, not queued twice

parts.text: I called `confirm_acceptance` because the product owner provided explicit Given/When/Then acceptance criteria covering the waiting list behavior, making the ticket ready for development.
